description: Agent-inbox unified retrieval (or successor) consumes `WidgetDeclaration` to render component widgets inline. ui-health remains contract + index only; runtime ownership lives downstream.

requirements.description: The agent-inbox unified retrieval system (or successor) must be able to consume `WidgetDeclaration` proto messages from the ui-health index to render component widgets inline. ui-health's responsibility is limited to defining the contract and maintaining the index; runtime rendering ownership lives in the downstream consumer. This requirement documents the interface contract that agent-inbox must honor when implementing consumption.
requirements.title: WidgetDeclaration Consumer Integration Contract

validation.notes: WidgetDeclaration proto messages stored in the ui-health index are queryable by widget metadata fields
ui-health exposes no runtime rendering code; all widget rendering logic resides in the consuming system
Agent-inbox (or mock consumer) can retrieve WidgetDeclaration records from the ui-health index via the defined query interface
A WidgetDeclaration record round-trips from ui-health index to consumer without field loss
The separation of concerns is documented: ui-health owns contract + index, agent-inbox owns runtime widget rendering
Future framework widget integrations require only a new `@vrooliWidget` annotation and reindex; no ui-health code changes are needed

title: Widget standard consumer integration
